read.title: Video Meeting Etiquette
read.text:
To keep our online meetings efficient, please follow these simple rules. Join a few minutes early to test your connection and audio. Keep yourself on mute when you are not speaking, especially in large meetings, to reduce background noise.

If you want to speak, use the raise-hand button instead of interrupting. When you share your screen, close any private messages or unrelated tabs first.

After each meeting, the organizer will follow up with a short summary and a list of action items within 24 hours.

write.en: You dropped off a video meeting because of a bad connection. Write a message apologizing and asking what you missed.
write.model:
Hi all,

Sorry about dropping off the call earlier. My connection was unstable, and I couldn't rejoin. Could someone share a quick summary of what I missed after the budget discussion? I'll follow up on my action items by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Minsu
